parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the HAVIP.

The description must be 1 to 255 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: IpAddress
parameters.description:
The IP address of the HAVIP.

The specified IP address must be an idle IP address within vSwitch CIDR block of the vSwitch. If you do not specify this parameter, an idle IP address is randomly assigned from vSwitch CIDR block of the specified vSwitch.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the HAVIP.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the HAVIP. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the HAVIP belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the HAVIP belongs.
